verses.original: אִ֛ישׁ הָיָ֥ה בְאֶֽרֶץ־ ע֖וּץ אִיּ֣וֹב שְׁמ֑וֹ וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֗וּא תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר וִירֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֥ר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš hā·yāh ḇə·’e·reṣ- ‘ūṣ ’î·yō·wḇ šə·mōw wə·hā·yāh hā·’îš ha·hū tām wə·yā·šār wî·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·sār mê·rā‘
verses.literal: There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job And this man was blameless and upright fearing God and shunning evil
verses.literalPt: HAVIA um homem na terra de Uz, cujo nome era Jó; e era este homem íntegro, reto e temente a Deus e desviava-se do mal.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּ֥לְדוּ ל֛וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥ה בָנִ֖ים וְשָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·lə·ḏū lōw šiḇ·‘āh ḇā·nîm wə·šā·lō·wōš bā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: He had seven sons and three daughters
verses.literalPt: E nasceram-lhe sete filhos e três filhas.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י מִ֠קְנֵהוּ שִֽׁבְעַ֨ת אַלְפֵי־ צֹ֜אן וּשְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֣י גְמַלִּ֗ים וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֤וֹת צֶֽמֶד־ בָּקָר֙ וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֲתוֹנ֔וֹת וַעֲבֻדָּ֖ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיְהִי֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא גָּד֖וֹל מִכָּל־ בְּנֵי־ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·nê·hū šiḇ·‘aṯ ’al·p̄ê- ṣōn ū·šə·lō·šeṯ ’al·p̄ê ḡə·mal·lîm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ ṣe·meḏ- bā·qār wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ ’ă·ṯō·w·nō·wṯ wa·‘ă·ḇud·dāh rab·bāh mə·’ōḏ way·hî hā·’îš ha·hū gā·ḏō·wl mik·kāl bə·nê- qe·ḏem
verses.literal: and he owned . . . 7,000 . . . sheep 3,000 . . . camels 500 . . . yoke of oxen 500 . . . female donkeys and a very . . . large number of servants Job was the greatest man of all the people of the East
verses.literalPt: E o seu gado era de sete mil ovelhas, três mil camelos, quinhentas juntas de bois e quinhentas jumentas; eram também muitíssimos os servos a seu serviço, de maneira que este homem era maior do que todos os do oriente.

verses.original: וְהָלְכ֤וּ בָנָיו֙ וְעָשׂ֣וּ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אִ֣ישׁ יוֹמ֑וֹ וְשָׁלְח֗וּ וְקָרְאוּ֙ לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אַחְיֹתֵיהֶם לֶאֱכֹ֥ל וְלִשְׁתּ֖וֹת עִמָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·lə·ḵū ḇā·nāw wə·‘ā·śū miš·teh bêṯ ’îš yō·w·mōw wə·šā·lə·ḥū wə·qā·rə·’ū liš·lō·šeṯ ʾaḥ·yō·ṯē·hɛm le·’ĕ·ḵōl wə·liš·tō·wṯ ‘im·mā·hem
verses.literal: Job’s sons would take turns holding feasts in their homes . . . . . . and they would invite . . . their three sisters to eat and drink with them
verses.literalPt: E iam seus filhos à casa uns dos outros e faziam banquetes cada um por sua vez; e mandavam convidar as suas três irmãs a comerem e beberem com eles.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י כִּ֣י הִקִּיפֽוּ֩ יְמֵ֨י הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֜ה וַיִּשְׁלַ֧ח אִיּ֣וֹב וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֗ם וְהִשְׁכִּ֣ים בַּבֹּקֶר֮ וְהֶעֱלָ֣ה עֹלוֹת֮ מִסְפַּ֣ר כֻּלָּם֒ כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר אִיּ֔וֹב אוּלַי֙ חָטְא֣וּ בָנַ֔י וּבֵרֲכ֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּלְבָבָ֑ם כָּ֛כָה יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אִיּ֖וֹב כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî hiq·qî·p̄ū yə·mê ham·miš·teh way·yiš·laḥ ’î·yō·wḇ way·qad·də·šêm wə·hiš·kîm bab·bō·qer wə·he·‘ĕ·lāh ‘ō·lō·wṯ mis·par kul·lām kî ’ā·mar ’î·yō·wḇ ’ū·lay ḥā·ṭə·’ū ḇā·nay ū·ḇê·ră·ḵū ’ĕ·lō·hîm bil·ḇā·ḇām kā·ḵāh ya·‘ă·śeh ’î·yō·wḇ kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: And when the days of feasting were over Job would send for his children to purify them rising early in the morning to offer burnt offerings . . . for all of them For Job thought Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts This was Job’s regular . . . practice
verses.literalPt: Sucedia, pois, que, decorrido o turno de dias de seus banquetes, enviava Jó, e os santificava, e se levantava de madrugada, e oferecia holocaustos segundo o número de todos eles; porque dizia Jó: Talvez pecaram meus filhos, e amaldiçoaram a Deus no seu coração. Assim fazia Jó continuamente.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּב֥וֹא גַֽם־ הַשָּׂטָ֖ן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm way·yā·ḇō·’ū bə·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- Yah·weh way·yā·ḇō·w ḡam- haś·śā·ṭān bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: One day the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD and Satan also came with them
verses.literalPt: E num dia em que os filhos de Deus vieram apresentar-se perante o SENHOR, veio também Satanás entre eles.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֖ן מֵאַ֣יִן תָּבֹ֑א וַיַּ֨עַן הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מִשּׁ֣וּט בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵֽהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān mê·’a·yin tā·ḇō way·ya·‘an haś·śā·ṭān ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yō·mar miš·šūṭ bā·’ā·reṣ ū·mê·hiṯ·hal·lêḵ bāh
verses.literal: Where have you come from said the LORD to Satan From roaming through the earth he - . . . replied and walking back and forth in it
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR disse a Satanás: Donde vens? E Satanás respondeu ao SENHOR, e disse: De rodear a terra, e passear por ela.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן הֲשַׂ֥מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֖ עַל־ עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין כָּמֹ֙הוּ֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֥ר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān hă·śam·tā lib·bə·ḵā ‘al- ‘aḇ·dî ’î·yō·wḇ kî ’ên kā·mō·hū bā·’ā·reṣ ’îš tām wə·yā·šār yə·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·sār mê·rā‘
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Satan Have you considered . . . . . . My servant Job For there is no one on earth like him a man who is blameless and upright who fears God and shuns evil
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Satanás: Observaste tu a meu servo Jó? Porque ninguém há na terra semelhante a ele, homem íntegro e reto, temente a Deus, e que se desvia do mal.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן הַשָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַֽחִנָּ֔ם יָרֵ֥א אִיּ֖וֹב אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an haś·śā·ṭān ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yō·mar ha·ḥin·nām yā·rê ’î·yō·wḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Satan answered the LORD . . . Does Job fear God for nothing
verses.literalPt: Então respondeu Satanás ao SENHOR, e disse: Porventura teme Jó a Deus debalde?

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־ אַתְּ שַׂ֣כְתָּ בַעֲד֧וֹ וּבְעַד־ בֵּית֛וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ מִסָּבִ֑יב מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָיו֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּמִקְנֵ֖הוּ פָּרַ֥ץ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- ʾat śaḵ·tā ḇa·‘ă·ḏōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ- bê·ṯōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw mis·sā·ḇîḇ ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw bê·raḵ·tā ū·miq·nê·hū pā·raṣ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Have You not . . . placed a hedge on every side around him . . . and his household and all that he owns You have blessed the work of his hands and his possessions have increased in the land
verses.literalPt: Porventura tu não cercaste de sebe, a ele, e a sua casa, e a tudo quanto tem? A obra de suas mãos abençoaste e o seu gado se tem aumentado na terra.

verses.original: וְאוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח־ נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֖ע בְּכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ אִם־ לֹ֥א עַל־ פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְבָרֲכֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām šə·laḥ- nā yā·ḏə·ḵā wə·ḡa‘ bə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lōw ’im- lō ‘al- pā·ne·ḵā yə·ḇā·ră·ḵe·kā
verses.literal: But stretch out . . . Your hand and strike all that he has and he will surely . . . curse You to Your face
verses.literalPt: Mas estende a tua mão, e toca-lhe em tudo quanto tem, e verás se não blasfema contra ti na tua face.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה כָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ רַ֣ק אֵלָ֔יו אַל־ תִּשְׁלַ֖ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵעִ֖ם פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān hin·nêh ḵāl ’ă·šer- lōw bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā raq ’ê·lāw ’al- tiš·laḥ yā·ḏe·ḵā way·yê·ṣê haś·śā·ṭān mê·‘im pə·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Very well said the LORD to Satan Everything he has is in your hands but you must not lay a hand on the man himself Then Satan . . . went out from the presence of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Satanás: Eis que tudo quanto ele tem está na tua mão; somente contra ele não estendas a tua mão. E Satanás saiu da presença do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וּבָנָ֨יו וּבְנֹתָ֤יו אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְשֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן בְּבֵ֖ית אֲחִיהֶ֥ם הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm ū·ḇā·nāw ū·ḇə·nō·ṯāw ’ō·ḵə·lîm wə·šō·ṯîm ya·yin bə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḥî·hem hab·bə·ḵō·wr
verses.literal: One day while Job’s sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu um dia, em que seus filhos e suas filhas comiam, e bebiam vinho, na casa de seu irmão primogênito,

verses.original: וּמַלְאָ֛ךְ בָּ֥א אֶל־ אִיּ֖וֹב וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַבָּקָר֙ הָי֣וּ חֹֽרְשׁ֔וֹת וְהָאֲתֹנ֖וֹת רֹע֥וֹת עַל־ יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·’āḵ bā ’el- ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar hab·bā·qār hā·yū ḥō·rə·šō·wṯ wə·hā·’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ rō·‘ō·wṯ ‘al- yə·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: a messenger came and reported to Job While the oxen were plowing and the donkeys were grazing nearby . . .
verses.literalPt: Que veio um mensageiro a Jó, e lhe disse: Os bois lavravam, e as jumentas pastavam junto a eles;

verses.original: וַתִּפֹּ֤ל שְׁבָא֙ וַתִּקָּחֵ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וָֽאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־ אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tip·pōl šə·ḇā wat·tiq·qā·ḥêm wə·’eṯ- han·nə·‘ā·rîm hik·kū lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ wā·’im·mā·lə·ṭāh raq- ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî lə·hag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: the Sabeans swooped down and took them away They put the servants to the sword and I alone have escaped . . . to tell you
verses.literalPt: E deram sobre eles os sabeus, e os tomaram, e aos servos feriram ao fio da espada; e só eu escapei para trazer-te a nova.

verses.original: ע֣וֹד׀ זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְזֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַר֒ אֵ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֗ים נָֽפְלָה֙ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַתִּבְעַ֥ר בַּצֹּ֛אן וּבַנְּעָרִ֖ים וַתֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־ אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ zeh mə·ḏab·bêr wə·zeh bā way·yō·mar ’êš ’ĕ·lō·hîm nā·p̄ə·lāh min- haš·šā·ma·yim wat·tiḇ·‘ar baṣ·ṣōn ū·ḇan·nə·‘ā·rîm wat·tō·ḵə·lêm wā·’im·mā·lə·ṭāh raq- ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî lə·hag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: While he was still speaking another messenger came and reported The fire of God fell from heaven It burned and consumed the sheep and the servants and I alone have escaped . . . to tell you
verses.literalPt: Estando este ainda falando, veio outro e disse: Fogo de Deus caiu do céu, e queimou as ovelhas e os servos, e os consumiu, e só eu escapei para trazer-te a nova.

verses.original: ע֣וֹד׀ זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְזֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַר֒ כַּשְׂדִּ֞ים שָׂ֣מוּ׀ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֗ים וַֽיִּפְשְׁט֤וּ עַל־ הַגְּמַלִּים֙ וַיִּקָּח֔וּם וְאֶת־ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־ אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ zeh mə·ḏab·bêr wə·zeh bā way·yō·mar kaś·dîm śā·mū šə·lō·šāh rā·šîm way·yip̄·šə·ṭū ‘al- hag·gə·mal·lîm way·yiq·qā·ḥūm wə·’eṯ- han·nə·‘ā·rîm hik·kū lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ wā·’im·mā·lə·ṭāh raq- ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî lə·hag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: While he was still speaking another messenger came and reported The Chaldeans formed three bands raided the camels and took them away They put the servants to the sword and I alone have escaped . . . to tell you
verses.literalPt: Estando ainda este falando, veio outro, e disse: Ordenando os caldeus três tropas, deram sobre os camelos, e os tomaram, e aos servos feriram ao fio da espada; e só eu escapei para trazer-te a nova.

verses.original: עַ֚ד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְזֶ֖ה בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֤יךָ אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְשֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן בְּבֵ֖ית אֲחִיהֶ֥ם הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ zeh mə·ḏab·bêr wə·zeh bā way·yō·mar bā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā ’ō·ḵə·lîm wə·šō·ṯîm ya·yin bə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḥî·hem hab·bə·ḵō·wr
verses.literal: While he was still speaking another messenger came and reported Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house
verses.literalPt: Estando ainda este falando, veio outro, e disse: Estando teus filhos e tuas filhas comendo e bebendo vinho, em casa de seu irmão primogênito,

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֩ ר֨וּחַ גְּדוֹלָ֜ה בָּ֣אָה׀ מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיִּגַּע֙ בְּאַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הַבַּ֔יִת וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים וַיָּמ֑וּתוּ וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־ אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh rū·aḥ gə·ḏō·w·lāh bā·’āh mê·‘ê·ḇer ham·miḏ·bār way·yig·ga‘ bə·’ar·ba‘ pin·nō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ way·yip·pōl ‘al- han·nə·‘ā·rîm way·yā·mū·ṯū wā·’im·mā·lə·ṭāh raq- ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî lə·hag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house It collapsed on the young people and they are dead and I alone have escaped . . . to tell you
verses.literalPt: Eis que um grande vento sobreveio dalém do deserto, e deu nos quatro cantos da casa, que caiu sobre os jovens, e morreram; e só eu escapei para trazer-te a nova.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קָם אִיּוֹב֙ וַיִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת־ מְעִל֔וֹ וַיָּ֖גָז אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ’î·yō·wḇ way·yiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- mə·‘i·lōw way·yā·ḡāz ’eṯ- rō·šōw way·yip·pōl ’ar·ṣāh way·yiš·tā·ḥū
verses.literal: Then Job stood up tore his robe and shaved his head He fell to the ground and worshiped
verses.literalPt: Então Jó se levantou, e rasgou o seu manto, e rapou a sua cabeça, e se lançou em terra, e adorou.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ עָרֹ֨ם יָצָתִי מִבֶּ֣טֶן אִמִּ֗י וְעָרֹם֙ אָשׁ֣וּב שָׁ֔מָה יְהוָ֣ה נָתַ֔ן וַיהוָ֖ה לָקָ֑ח יְהִ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה מְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ā·rōm yå̄·ṣå̄·ṯī mib·be·ṭen ’im·mî wə·‘ā·rōm ’ā·šūḇ šå̄·må̄h Yah·weh nā·ṯan Yah·weh lā·qāḥ yə·hî šêm Yah·weh mə·ḇō·rāḵ
verses.literal: saying Naked I came from my mother’s womb and naked I will return . . . The LORD gave and the LORD has taken away Blessed be the name of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E disse: Nu saí do ventre de minha mãe e nu tornarei para lá; o SENHOR o deu, e o SENHOR o tomou: bendito seja o nome do SENHOR.

verses.original: בְּכָל־ זֹ֖את לֹא־ חָטָ֣א אִיּ֑וֹב וְלֹא־ נָתַ֥ן תִּפְלָ֖ה לֵאלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl zōṯ lō- ḥā·ṭā ’î·yō·wḇ wə·lō- nā·ṯan tip̄·lāh lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: In all this Job did not sin or charge God with wrongdoing
verses.literalPt: Em tudo isto Jó não pecou, nem atribuiu a Deus falta alguma.
